newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $618 mln in Oct's last week - source.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $618 mln in Oct's last week - source.

text.p: Brazilian exports in the final week of October were $618 million, a government source said.
The Ministry of Industry and Commerce was due to announce the official October export figure at 1300 local/1500 GMT.
Exports up to the end of the fourth week of the month were $3.57 billion, which would make total exports for October some $4.188 billion.
The government source did not specifically reveal the total monthly export figure, adding that some six hours of shipments were lost in the fifth week due to a computer glitch.
